title: Requirements and rehearsals
notes: Actions now have requirements. You need 3 songs for a writers' round, a released single for a radio tour or late-night TV, 5 recorded songs and a single for an album, and shows, songs, a manager, an album or a Top 10 hit for bigger venues and tours. Locked actions show a 🔒 and a checklist of what you still need. Stars like Rayna and Juliette count their back catalogs.

Rehearsals: your manager calls you in for production rehearsals when a tour starts, before big shows like the Ryman and the Opry, before your awards performance, and when the band gets rusty. Answer, ask to move it, or skip it (they won't be happy).

The rehearsal room is a 3D soundstage with your band and your manager watching. Pick two things to work on (the setlist, transitions, the new song, vocal warm-ups, soundcheck, production cues, harmonies), then watch the run-through. A good rehearsal makes your next shows better and cuts down on things going wrong. Skip tour rehearsals and the first shows suffer.
